title: Independent Data Science Research & Engineering
rules: This block represents genuine independent technical work, not salaried employment, freelance client work, consulting or a company role.
The title, organisation label and dates are locked and must not be tailored to mimic the target job title.
Every bullet must be traceable to verified current project or repository evidence.
Use evidence_refs to identify the projects or evidence owners supporting the block.
Do not use Career Break, Upskilling, Between Roles, Job Search or equivalent defensive gap language in the CV.
Do not claim clients, revenue, production deployment, employment, consulting or paid work unless separately verified.
The Projects section may provide detailed proof for the same body of work, but must not repeat Independent Practice bullets verbatim.
Independent Practice is current-work chronology, while Projects is the proof layer.
Omit the block only on explicit Varun instruction or when Independent Review records a role-specific strategic reason.
